summary.text: Jay Taylor is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 14 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A U.S. Army veteran who works as a supervisor, he is a West Virginia University graduate.

paragraphs.text: Jay Taylor served in the U.S. Army from 1990 to 1996 and earned a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from West Virginia University in 2000 and 2008, respectively.
His career experience includes working as a supervisor.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Taylor said he had been involved in politics for about 30 years, including as chairman of his county executive committee and as the West Virginia legislative liaison for the Convention of States Project.
He described himself in that survey as "a Conservative, Pro-Life, 2nd Amendment, Right sized Government, Republican," and listed infrastructure and education among his key messages.
Taylor took office in the State Senate on December 1, 2022, succeeding David Sypolt.

In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee and also serves on the Confirmations, Education, Energy, Industry and Mining, Health and Human Resources, Interstate Cooperation, Judiciary, Military and Rules committees.
